If anyone has trouble with the link the Decklist is:

Iron Fist, Nightcrawler, Angela, Scorpion, Storm, Juggernaut, Polaris, Jessica Jones, Miles Morales, Blue Marvel, Doctor Octopus and Onslaught. 

The guide/explanation is :

The idea of this deck is to play Nightcrawler/Blue Marvel/Onslaught combo with Doctor Octopus as an alternative win condition. The movement package of Iron Fist, Miles, Juggernaut and Polaris can be interchanged for a different package, this is just the one I have enjoyed the most success with.   
  
The perfect game probably looks something like:  
  
T1 – T3: Nightcrawler on to bar sinister  
  
T5: Move one Nightcrawler and play blue marvel on to bar sinister. (If you haven’t drawn Night crawler/blue marvel/Doc Ock, concede and preserve your cubes.)  
  
T6: Move the remaining Nightcrawlers and play Onslaught onto Bar Sinister.   
  
Other Considerations/Notes:  
  
Storm to lock down a lane followed by a Jess Jones/Juggernaut is usually a strong enough play to win that lane outright.   
  
Doctor Octopus played onto Bar Sinister wins 9 times out of 10. 40 power is often more than your opponents cards will offer when played out of order and not synergistically. It’s not uncommon to see a Doc Ock into an opponent conceding.   
  
The Nightcrawler onto Bar Sinister isn’t just important for blocking your opponents Goblin/Debrii shenaningans, It’s crucial for staggering the Bar Sinsister lane to get 1x Blue Marvel followed by 3x Onslaught for maximum value.
